title: Sunset cruise in Barcelona worth every penny.
text: The trip was fantastic. Jorge was a great captain. He explained what we would do and see. He gave us information on the places we were seeing from the water. Have is some history. The ride was fantastic. The sunset was amazing. Highly recommend this outing.
author: derekfZ3125NL

title: Highly recommend
text: Jorge, thank you so much for our amazing sailing experience! It was my family’s first time sailing in Barcelona and we absolutely loved it!
author: lilylO2688FN

title: Great Sunset Sailing Cruise.
text: It was an experience. Captain Jorge was awesome! He was pleasant and provided a nice spread of snacks and offered drinks. It is definitely a bargain. The atmosphere was great and the views even better. I also enjoyed how it was a small group. I feel it would be a great experience for friends, a small group, or your partner. I also find it pretty cool that his son was willing to help out around the boat as well. Overall great time and would recommend it for anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: jjo475

title: Barcelona Sunset Cruise
text: Captain Jorge is a wonderful Captain and host.  His sailboat is very beautiful and clean. We had a wonderful sunset cruise in Barcelona with friends.  It could not have been a better experience. I highly recommend this cruise.
author: 333glennism

title: Sailboat cruise
text: My wife and I had a wonderful sailboat cruise aboard the Aruba on June 13. Jorge, our host and captain, made the entire experience exceptional. He was welcoming, attentive, and clearly skilled at the helm, guiding us smoothly through the water while sharing thoughtful insights about the area. The atmosphere was peaceful, the views were stunning, and Jorge’s calm, friendly presence made the outing feel both personal and memorable. We left feeling relaxed, grateful, and eager to sail with him again.
author: Teodoro_A

title: 5 star vibes
text: The captain was an absolute G. Super accommodating. We were a bit lost and he hopped on the phone with our cab driver to make sure we ended up at the right place.
author: Alexander_F

title: Best sea cruise ever
text:
Beautiful night on the sea! Our host was so interesting and fun to hear his experiences. 
Loved it !!!!
author: Patricia_C

title: Perfect tour 🤩
text: We had a great time. The sunset was perfect and the captain took great care of our well-being.
author: stephan_zuerich

title: Fantastic way to spend an evening in Barcelona.
text: Jorge was fantastic. He took us out even though there was only two of us. The sunset was beautiful, the drinks and snacks provided were perfect (tried the Cava). And the music made the experience even better. I’m so glad I chose this excursion over all the other options. What a great way to spend an evening!! Thank you Jorge!!
author: bonnieh273

title: Must do!
text: This was a beautiful sail boat. The weather was perfect and Barcelona at night was stunningly beautiful. If you’re in the city this is something you have to do. Jorge is amazing!
author: Debimac74
